title: Schwartz–Zippel bound
statement: Let $m,d\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $p\in\mathbb{Z}[X_1,\ldots,X_m]$ be a nonzero polynomial of total degree at most $d$. For any finite nonempty set $S\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$, the fraction of tuples in $S^m$ at which $p$ is nonzero is at least $1-d/|S|$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a polynomial over the integers in $m$ variables
$d$ is a natural number and the total degree of $p$ is at most $d$
$S$ is a finite nonempty subset of the integers
